Space agency launches lunar rover

The rover lifted off at dawn and is expected to land near the moon's south pole in five days.

Key points

  • Launch happened on schedule after two earlier delays
  • The rover carries instruments to search for frozen water
Pinned 07:42

Rover separates from the rocket

Mission control confirmed a clean separation a little over an hour after launch.

07:15

Engineers in the control room applauded as the second stage ignited.

What a morning. Months of work in a few minutes of fire.

06:58

Liftoff

The rocket cleared the tower and rolled toward the east.
